title: DW Homes
body:
# How to use

- /home
- After doing /home a GUI will open with 5 beds, click on one to set your current position as a home.

# config.yml:

```
max_homes: 5 # The max the plugin supports is 9
teleport_warmup_seconds: 5
teleport_cooldown_seconds: 30
home_name_format: "Home %number%"
cancel:
  move: true
  damage: true

color: 9 
#0: Black
#1: Dark Blue
#2: Dark Green
#3: Dark Aqua (Cyan)
#4: Dark Red
#5: Dark Purple
#6: Gold
#7: Gray
#8: Dark Gray
#9: Blue
#a: Green
#b: Aqua (Light Blue)
#c: Red
#d: Light Purple (Pink)
#e: Yellow
#f: White
```
